name: @optiplan360/frontend-bundle-optimizer
description: Frontend bundle size optimization and lazy loading for OptiPlan360

scripts.build:analyze: vite build --mode production && npx vite-bundle-analyzer dist/stats.html
scripts.build:report: vite build --mode production && npx webpack-bundle-analyzer dist/static/js/*.js
scripts.lighthouse: npm run build && npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173 --output=reports
